column4: Vertical and lateral constraints on resistivity were run with values of 5.0 and 2.0 and a homogeneous half-space with resistivity values of 40 ohm-meters for the prior model.  Sensor altitude was treated as a free parameter with an a-priori standard deviation of 0.5 m and a lateral constraint standard deviation factor of 1.30.
